primitives.name: QuotientSystem
primitives.statement: There is a carrier X with an equivalence relation and quotient map q:X->X/~.
primitives.operational_definition: A set, an equivalence relation, and quotient projection.

primitives.name: Observable
primitives.statement: There is a real-valued observable f:X->R.
primitives.operational_definition: A function from the carrier to real values.

definitions.name: ObservableOscillation
definitions.statement: epsilon_f is the supremum of |f(x)-f(y)| over equivalent x,y.

definitions.name: ExactObservableDescent
definitions.statement: There exists f_bar on the quotient such that f=f_bar o q.

definitions.name: ApproximateObservableDescent
definitions.statement: A quotient observable approximates f within a declared pointwise error bound.

claims.statement: An observable descends exactly to the quotient iff it is constant on every equivalence class.
If within-class oscillation is at most epsilon, any representative-based quotient observable has pointwise error at most epsilon.
For real-valued observables with class extrema, the class midpoint quotient observable has worst-case error at most epsilon/2.
Preservation of selected operations does not imply preservation of arbitrary observables.
Useful effective physical descriptions may be characterized by bounded residuals for a selected observable family under approximate quotient maps.

observables.name: WithinClassOscillation
observables.definition: Maximum or supremum variation of an observable inside quotient classes.

falsifiers.condition: Give an exactly descended observable that is not class-constant, or a class-constant observable that does not descend.
For a real-valued class with finite extrema, produce midpoint error exceeding half the class oscillation.

metadata.purpose: Formalize exact and approximate observable descent under quotient coarse-graining.
